spans.s:
f. (-ञ्चा)
The tamarind tree.
E.
चम to eat, affix क्विप्, and the radical vowel changed, चिम् then, चर to go, with ड affix, and the fem. form; what becomes edible.

mfn. (-कः)
A sort of grass, commonly Ceñcrā.

m. (-म्लः)
An acid potherb, (Rumex vesicatorius.)
E.
चिञ्चा, and अम्ल sour.

m. (-रः)
A sort of potherb, (Rumex vesicatorius.)
E.
चिञ्चा, and सार essence.
